# Design point P007

## Description

Repository state changes are persisted in batched write-ahead logs to reduce object-storage overhead, while request routing avoids unavailable or degraded file servers. Clients can also perform repository work without contacting the centralized host; this offline mode operates outside the normal coordination path and may require separate synchronization not specified here.
